exposure: Various interventions (e.g., membrane sweeping, castor oil, nipple stimulation)
finding: This clinical practice guideline provides evidence-based recommendations on cervical ripening and induction of labor, aiming to optimize perinatal care while avoiding unnecessary interventions.
mod_finding: The guideline recommends offering induction of labor at or after 41 weeks gestation (late-term induction), at 39 weeks gestation for advanced maternal age (≥40 years), and in the setting of term pre-labor rupture of membranes for women with positive Group B Streptococcus status.
gest_age: Varies depending on the specific recommendation
birth_weight: Ultrasound estimated fetal weight >4500 g in the presence of diabetes and estimated fetal weight >5000 g in the absence of diabetes
